$comment: Official migration tools, matched by package name. Placeholders: {to} = target version, {toMajor} = target major, {pm} = package manager, {pmx} = its package runner (npx, pnpm dlx, yarn dlx, bunx). Every entry needs a source URL; add entries only from official docs.

tools.summary: Expo SDK upgrade. Upgrade one SDK version at a time. `expo install --fix` aligns every Expo package (and React Native) with the SDK, so don't set expo-* versions by hand.
steps: With Continuous Native Generation, delete android/ and ios/ so the next build regenerates them; otherwise run pod-install and apply the native upgrade helper diff

tools.summary: Tamagui 2 → 3. Bump tamagui and every @tamagui/* package together and check the lockfile has no duplicate @tamagui/core or tamagui. The CLI prints the migration checklist and runs codemods (run them in report mode first, then --write).
Codemod for the removed positional overloads (useQuery(key, fn, opts) → useQuery({ queryKey, queryFn, ...opts })). Run after installing v5.
Angular. `ng update` bumps the framework packages together and runs their migration schematics. Follow the interactive update guide for the from/to pair.
Nx. `nx migrate <version>` updates package.json and writes migrations.json; install, then run the migrations. Go one major at a time (required for Angular workspaces).
Next.js. The upgrade codemod bumps next, react and react-dom together and runs the codemods; non-interactive under an agent or CI.
Storybook. `storybook upgrade` bumps every Storybook package together, runs automigrations and a health check. One major at a time (6 → 8 is the exception).
